server.name: Meta Wearables MCP Server
server.title: Meta Wearables Developer Platform
server.description: Search public DAT SDK and WebApps documentation and inspect authenticated Wearables Developer Center projects and releases.

live.instructions:
Meta Wearables developer platform: documentation search, plus read-only access to a developer's own Wearables Developer Center projects.

Pick the corpus that matches the question. `search_dat_docs` covers the Device Access Toolkit, the native iOS and Android SDK a third-party app uses to reach glasses hardware. `search_webapps_docs` covers web apps that run on the glasses. Search both when either could apply.

Both corpora are versioned and change between SDK releases, so search before answering rather than relying on recalled APIs, and quote the returned sections for version-specific details.

The `wdc_` tools read the caller's own projects, versions, builds and submissions. They require a Wearables Developer Center MCP token; without one, only documentation search is available.

tools.name: search_dat_docs
tools.description: Search public DAT SDK developer documentation, including guides, platform plugin setup, first DAT app setup, API references, and code examples. Use natural language queries like "how do I set up my first DAT app with AI" or exact API names like "MWDATCamera".
tools.title: Search DAT SDK Documentation

query.description: What to look up in the DAT SDK developer documentation. A natural-language question works as well as an exact API or configuration name.

max_results.description: How many documentation chunks to return. Ask for more to survey a topic broadly, fewer to keep the response short. Defaults to 5, and the search returns at most 10.

results.description: Search results as numbered plain text sections, ranked by semantic similarity.

returned_count.description: Number of documentation sections returned in the result.
